runners.name: Determinedfinisher
runners.comment: DETERMINEDFINISHER coaxed from the gate, chased three to four paths off the inside down the backstretch before tucking to the two path through the turn coming under coaxing three furlongs out, angled six wide into upper stretch advancing on the front, seized command straightened away and went clear under a drive to score.

runners.name: Blue Mountains
runners.comment: BLUE MOUNTAINS coaxed from the start, chased four then three wide under prolonged urging from the half mile pole, went eight wide into upper stretch, proved no match for the top one while up for the place honors in the final jumps to the wire.

runners.name: Sorrentino
runners.comment: SORRENTINO got bumped at the start by ASKED AND ANSWERED, dueled four then three wide with that rival to his inside, came under coaxing near the quarter pole and swung four wide into upper stretch, kept on to preserve the show honors clear of the rest.

runners.name: Asked and Answered
runners.comment: ASKED AND ANSWERED broke out at the start bumping SORRENTINO, dueled three then two wide under a ride from three furlongs out, spun three wide into upper stretch, weakened in the late stages.

runners.name: Gordy
runners.comment: GORDY coaxed from the gate, chased five paths off the inside down the backstretch and through the turn under prolonged urging from the half mile pole, tipped six wide into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Enticed Master
runners.comment: ENTICED MASTER broke a half a beat slow, chased just off the inside under a ride from three furlongs out, took the inside route into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Senior Lender
runners.comment: SENIOR LENDER chased five then four wide under encouragement from the seven-sixteenths pole, faded and spun just off the inside into upper stretch and faltered.

runners.name: Kaz Toro
runners.comment: KAZ TORO was hustled from the gate, showed speed then contested the pace, vied in the three then two path on the turn, shook clear under a right-handed crop in upper stretch, switched to a left-handed crop at the furlong marker, extended the advantage under a drive into the final sixteenth then swapped back to his inside lead and proved much the best while placed under a hand-ride from that point to the finish.

runners.name: Valentine Crusader
runners.comment: VALENTINE CRUSADER was urged along off the pace, chased while going from the two path to the four path on the turn, was driven into the stretch in the five path and safely secured the place.

runners.name: Tap Rules
runners.comment: TAP RULES was hustled from the gate, vied outside the leading duo, dropped from the five path to the four path on the turn, lost touch with the winner while coming out some under a drive in upper stretch and weakened but was well clear for the show.

runners.name: Term Premium
runners.comment: TERM PREMIUM was urged along on the inside of VALENTINE CRUSADER, shifted from the inside to the three path on the turn, came out into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: McRye
runners.comment: MCRYE dropped back while ridden along on the outside, traveled around the turn in the four path, came into the stretch in the six path and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Mr Dan
runners.comment: MR DAN was fractious behind the gate, saved ground while urged along at the rear, moved off the inside outside the quarter-pole and was no factor.

runners.name: Lombardo
runners.comment: LOMBARDO was hustled from the gate, showed speed then disputed the pace, vied inside on the turn, dropped back at the five-sixteenths pole and faded.

runners.name: Salt Spartan
runners.comment: SALT SPARTAN got brushed at the start by MAXIMUM HEAT, who broke outwards, raced just off the inside in closest aim of the leader coming under coaxing when taking command just outside the quarter pole, spun three wide into upper stretch, got headed for the front with three-sixteenths to go, dug in dueling through to the finish taking back the front a furlong out, and gamely prevailed at the finish.

runners.name: Manor Park
runners.comment: MANOR PARK three wide in range of the front, remained patiently handled until let out spinning four wide into upper stretch, rallied to take command three-sixteenths from home, dueled through to the finish getting headed a furlong out, fought on gamely to the end but was ultimately denied.

runners.name: Smilensaycheese
runners.comment: SMILENSAYCHEESE broke out at the start carrying out COACH CASE a path, raced three wide through the first turn before chasing four then three wide coming under a ride near the quarter pole, swung five wide into upper stretch, kept on to the wire.

runners.name: Diliello
runners.comment: DILIELLO bobbled at the break, chased three then two wide under urging from the five-sixteenths marker, swung four wide for home and weakened in the late stages.

runners.name: Blame It On K J
runners.comment: BLAME IT ON K J steadied when losing his lane at the start to COACH CASE due to pressure from SMILENSAYCHEESE, raced three then two wide through the first turn, took to the rail down the backstretch before racing just off the inside through the far turn coming under urging three furlongs out, went seven wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals.

runners.name: Coach Case
runners.comment: COACH CASE got carried out at the start by SMILENSAYCHEESE forcing BLAME IT ON K J to steady when taking over that rival's lane, chased just off the inside and then along the inside under urging from the five-sixteenths pole, went six wide into upper stretch and offered no response.

runners.name: Maximum Heat
runners.comment: MAXIMUM HEAT broke out at the start brushing SALT SPARTAN, chased along the inside under encouragement from three furlongs out, spun three wide into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Solo Empire
runners.comment: SOLO EMPIRE established the front and showed the way in hand along the inside, came under coaxing near the quarter pole and was displaced from the front, took the inside route into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Saintly Villain
runners.comment: SAINTLY VILLAIN settled off the pace, was asked while saving ground on the turn, moved to the two path later on that bend, rallied to the lead at the quarter-pole, drifted out while swapping back to her inside lead in upper stretch, went back to the proper lead while clear at the furlong marker and held under strong urging.

runners.name: Harpist
runners.comment: HARPIST tracked the pace on the outside, was given her cue in the three then four path on the turn, chased the winner under a drive while outside of READY SET ROLL into the final furlong, jostled with the aforementioned foe around the sixteenth-pole and willingly earned the place.

runners.name: Ready Set Roll
runners.comment: READY SET ROLL broke a half-step slow, settled off the pace, was roused in the two path on the turn, swung out into upper stretch, reached the five path while gaining around the three-sixteenths pole, chased inside of HARPIST into the final furlong, jostled with that opponent around the sixteenth-pole then steadied late and just missed the place but was clear for the show.

runners.name: Aerial Affair
runners.comment: AERIAL AFFAIR moved in while showing speed then set the pace, vied inside on the turn, was asked inside the five-sixteenths pole, lost the advantage at the quarter-pole, dropped back into the final furlong and tired.

runners.name: Shared Ambition
runners.comment: SHARED AMBITION was last away, moved in while settling at the rear, saved ground on the turn, spun into the stretch in the two path and was no factor.

runners.name: Mariner
runners.comment: MARINER prompted the pace on the outside of the leader, was asked in the two then three path on the turn, dropped back in upper stretch and capitulated.

runners.name: Unbroken Chain
runners.comment: UNBROKEN CHAIN hustled from the gate, cut the pace from the two path patiently handled until set down spinning two to three wide into upper stretch, drew off under a drive to prevail.

runners.name: Kid Billy
runners.comment: KID BILLY chased along the inside and then just off the inside under a ride from three furlongs out, spun three wide into upper stretch, ran on to secure the place honors on the wire.

runners.name: Tenebris
runners.comment: TENEBRIS chased two to three wide under encouragement from the five-sixteenths pole, cornered three wide into upper stretch, offered up a mild kick.

runners.name: Neuschwanstein
runners.comment: NEUSCHWANSTEIN coaxed from the gate, chased three wide in closest aim of the leader coming under urging three furlongs out, swung four wide for home, weakened in the stretch.

runners.name: Without Pretence
runners.comment: WITHOUT PRETENCE coaxed from the start, chased five wide under urging from the five-sixteenths pole, went seven wide into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Screaming Uncle
runners.comment: SCREAMING UNCLE urged from the gate, chased four paths off the inside down the backstretch and then five to six wide through the turn coming under motivation with five-sixteenths to run, went eight wide into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Bootleg Runner
runners.comment: BOOTLEG RUNNER urged from the start, chased eight paths off the inside until tucked four wide into the turn, tipped five wide into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Vicked
runners.comment: VICKED went to the front, raced inside on the first turn, attended the pace on the inside of GANDERELLA, vied along the rail while asked on the far turn, came out under pressure in upper stretch then was headed by the runner-up, fought on gamely into the final furlong, regained the advantage coming to the sixteenth-pole and prevailed under strong urging.

runners.name: Alesiamae
runners.comment: ALESIAMAE raced in the three path on the first turn, settled on the outside, ranged up in the three then two path on the far turn, was given her cue outside the quarter-pole, gained in the four path into the stretch, jostled with GANDERELLA while making a bid in the six path at the three-sixteenths pole then took the lead, lost the advantage back to the winner before the sixteenth-pole and missed while clear for the place.

runners.name: Ganderella
runners.comment: GANDERELLA established a forward position on the outside of two foes, raced in the three path on the first turn, attended the pace on the outside, vied in the two path on the far turn, was asked outside the quarter-pole, came out a bit into upper stretch, jostled with ALESIAMAE while in the five path at the three-sixteenths pole, fought with the top two into the final furlong and was outfinished but held the show.

runners.name: Take Charge Smarty
runners.comment: TAKE CHARGE SMARTY saved ground on the first turn, settled off the pace, shifted from the inside to the two path very early on the far turn, moved to the three path late on that bend, swung out to the five path into the stretch and lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Zap That Ghost
runners.comment: ZAP THAT GHOST dropped back early, rounded the first turn in the two path, settled off the pace, chased inside on the far turn and also lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Run Flat
runners.comment: RUN FLAT angled in at the rear, saved ground on the turns and was no factor.

runners.name: City War
runners.comment: CITY WAR showed speed on the inside of two opponents then was taken back, raced in the two path on the first turn, settled towards the front, dropped back with three furlongs to run, traveled around the far turn in the three path and failed to respond.

runners.name: Stand the Rain
runners.comment: STAND THE RAIN saved ground at the tail of the field patiently handled until placed to coaxing nearing the quarter pole, spun three wide into upper stretch, offered up a good kick to quickly rally on the leader taking narrow command a furlong out, then drew clear under a light drive and was geared down in the final jumps to the finish.

runners.name: Abigail
runners.comment: ABIGAIL brushed the off side stall at the start, showed the way in hand just off the inside on hold until roused taking the two path into upper stretch, dug in under threat and was overhauled a furlong out by her barn mate, ran on clear of the rest to be along second best.

runners.name: Alibi
runners.comment: ALIBI got bumped at the start by BOBBY M'S GIRL, chased along the inside under a ride from the five-sixteenths pole, continued in the inside route into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Bobby M's Girl
runners.comment: BOBBY M'S GIRL broke out at the start bumping ALIBI, chased just off the inside through the first turn and then three wide thereafter, came under urging near the quarter pole and continued three wide for home, tired in the drive.

runners.name: Tiz the Lady
runners.comment: TIZ THE LADY chased three then two wide in closest aim of the leader, came under encouragement near the five-sixteenths marker, swung four wide for home in retreat and faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: Whitby
runners.comment: WHITBY was hustled from the gate, showed speed on the inside of the runner-up then showed the way, vied inside while asked on the turn, dueled into the final furlong, shook clear nearing the sixteenth-pole and prevailed under steady urging.

runners.name: Supreme Good (IRE)
runners.comment: SUPREME GOOD (IRE) showed speed then pressed the pace on the outside, vied in the two path on the turn, spun into the stretch in the three path, dueled outside of the winner into the final furlong, drifted out under a left-handed crop outside the sixteenth-pole and was outfinished while clear for the place.

runners.name: Monte Avi
runners.comment: MONTE AVI was urged along off the pace, moved in around the eleven-sixteenths pole, went around the turn in the four then three path, swung out into upper stretch, reached the seven path around the three-sixteenths pole and improved for the show.

runners.name: Lucky Dragon
runners.comment: LUCKY DRAGON was hustled from the gate, showed speed on the outside then moved in after dropping off the pace, chased in the three path on the turn, turned into the stretch in the five path then moved out to the six path and lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Sociably Johnny
runners.comment: SOCIABLY JOHNNY saved ground towards the rear and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Good Bali
runners.comment: GOOD BALI moved in near the seven-eighths pole, was urged along well off the pace, dropped from the four path to the three path on the turn and failed tor respond.

runners.name: Corvus
runners.comment: CORVUS was hustled from the gate, moved out then chased the pace on the outside, traveled around the turn in the four path, came out to the seven path into upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: The Obliterator
runners.comment: THE OBLITERATOR settled well back on the outside, rounded the turn in the five path, spun into upper stretch in the seven path and showed little.

runners.name: Resilient Hero
runners.comment: RESILIENT HERO was hustled from the gate then urged along off the pace, moved from the four path to the three path on the turn and faltered.
